async def act(page):
    # Fill in the issue title
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title (required)')
    await title_textbox.fill('Connection refused in ChatGPT')
    
    # Fill in the issue description
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await description_textbox.fill('Issue: Connection refused when trying to access ChatGPT. Please investigate the network settings and server status.')
    
    # Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue')
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Get the issue URL after creation
    issue_url = page.url
    print(f"Issue created at: {issue_url}")
    return issue_url
